acceptanceCriteria: Delivered spec-first: numbered owner-accepted requirements in the owning spec, with focused tests or measured evidence tracing each.
Missing evidence yields an explicit unknown or abstention, never invented certainty; read commands stay read-only.
body:
Source: codex/w5-docs lane, GitHub #782.

Problem: basic JS/Go test-validity receipts do not retain the revision, so revision staleness cannot be claimed. Proposal: record the revision in those receipts and let consumers report stale-by-revision, otherwise keep NOT_OBSERVED.

completion.reason: Delivered in beamfall/corvint#799 (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/799; landed by batch PR #799); on main at 10efc02d16e6069d73426e6d6abd860e71ae83ab (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/799). Tests named in the PR: LPCVD-V0-005 doc gates. Doc gates, repin check, independent review and dogfood bind/check/seal reported PASS in the PR. make gate NOT_RUN (owner scoped-work preference); native claim unavailable (COVERAGE_UNKNOWN/RESOURCE_COLLISION). Evidence: sha256 of the build-log/decision record(s) at the merge commit.

title: Retain the revision in basic JS/Go test-validity receipts so revision staleness can be claimed (GitHub #782)
